text:
Nina S.: Hey folks, starting next Monday (6/7). A couple quick payroll/benefits logistics: 1) My offer included a $4k relocation reimbursement (receipts required) is that paid on first paycheck or after receipts are approved? 2) I picked the virtual commuter stipend option; there's a company holiday Thu of my first week will that block activation? 3) Domestic partner medical add-on what paperwork is sufficient if our lease is in my partner's name only?

Carla (People Ops): Welcome, Nina! Short answers: 1) Reimbursements that require receipts are paid after payroll confirms the receipts and approval typically post-payroll as an expense reimbursement line, not the signing bonus flow. 2) Virtual commuter often activates faster but requires HR activation + direct deposit/I-9. Holidays can delay by 1-2 days. 3) If lease is only in partner's name we accept a signed DP affidavit + a secondary supporting doc (joint bank stmt, shared utility, or a letter from landlord).

Nina S.: Ah ok so receipts = separate reimbursement; good to know. Is there a template for the landlord letter?

Mei (Benefits): We have a landlord letter template in the benefits portal under "DP verification docs". It must be dated within 60 days and include both names and the address. If you upload the affidavit + landlord letter, we can process DP enrollment quickly. Enroll within 30 days of your start date.

Ben (Payroll): To add on timing: expense reimbursements run on the next payable cycle after approvals are final. If you submit receipts by 6/10 we can aim for the 6/21 payroll (paid 6/28). Signing/relocation bonuses are different those are supplemental wages and listed on payroll. Also note commuter stipend taxability depends on state which state are you in?

Nina S.: I'm in WA. Also I uploaded the affidavit and a pdf landlord letter to the portal just now, status shows "awaiting review".

Carla (People Ops): Got the upload, thanks. Mei, can Benefits review and mark verification?

Mei (Benefits): I see it. I'll mark it for expedited review and update status within 24 hours. For the landlord letter, please ensure it includes landlord contact and today's date.

Ben (Payroll): WA note: commuter stipend is generally non-taxable up to the federal transit benefit limit if set up correctly, but state/local can differ. I'll DM you a quick estimate for net reimbursement and any withholding on the relocation line once we know whether it's a taxable bonus or an expense reimbursement.

ops-bot: Reminder: Upload receipts for relocation reimbursements within 60 days of expense. Benefits enrollment window: 30 days from start. Required for DP: signed affidavit + supporting doc.

Nina S.: Thanks everyone I'll confirm the landlord letter has contact info and DM Ben my payroll state details. Appreciate the quick help! :smile:
